data.name: Private Custom Activities Combo Charter
data.headline: Private, fully customizable Key West boat charter for sandbars, snorkeling, dolphins, sunset, casual family fishing, and special occasions.
data.description:
The most flexible charter Six Fins offers. Combine sandbars, snorkeling, dolphin watching, sightseeing, sunset, and other activities in one private day. Casual fishing may be included as one part of the itinerary and is best for children, beginners, and families who simply want to wet a line. It does not provide the preparation, fishing time, effort, or focus of a dedicated fishing charter. If you want a true Key West fishing experience, reserve our Private Patch Reef Fishing charter. Your USCG-licensed captain builds the route around your priorities and current conditions aboard the 30' Jeanneau yacht. Group-only — no shared boat.

Quick facts:
• 6 hrs $1,395
• 8 hrs $1,795
• 10 hrs $2,195
• Private
• USCG-licensed captain
• Perry Hotel & Marina
• Fuel + safety gear included

* Fully customizable private charter tailored to your group
* Experienced local captains with local knowledge
* Dolphin watching in natural habitat
* Snorkeling vibrant reefs and clear backcountry waters
* Sandbar stops ideal for celebrations and relaxation
* Flexible start times to fit your schedule
data.itinerary:
1. Meet at The Perry Hotel & Marina, Dock A, Slip #32; brief safety overview and flexible departure time.
2. Dolphin search and scenic harbor cruise with local commentary.
3. Snorkeling over reefs or backcountry patch reefs; snorkel gear provided.
4. Sandbar stop for swimming, floating, and relaxing.
5. Optional activities may include casual fishing for children and beginners when arranged in advance and conditions permit, a sunset extension, backwater eco tour, or harbor restaurant stop; return cruise to the marina.

data.cancellation_notes:
Enjoy peace of mind with our cancellation policy:

All reservations made within 7 calendar days of departure are non-refundable. Customer cancellations made prior to 7 calendar days before departure will receive a full refund. If Six Fins Charter cancels due to unsafe weather conditions or other circumstances initiated by the owner/operator, the customer will receive a full refund.
data.booking_notes:
IMPORTANT ACTION REQUIRED
Six Fins Charter – Booking Confirmation

Dear Guests,

We're excited to welcome you aboard your private Six Fins Charter experience! Please review the important details below to ensure a smooth and memorable day on the water.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

✅ Before Your Trip

For trips up to six passengers:

👉 Each passenger must complete the insurance waiver (including adults on behalf of minors): [here] (https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/rd9k5tiavpwper7h2rhaqh/web/)

AND for trips with 7th and 8th passengers:

👉 The primary renter (21+ years old) and captain must complete the Bareboat Agreement together at the dock before departure, but prior to arrival, you may begin: [here](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/ez5636zbxexwrng7dtz6mq/web/)

I acknowledge that for groups of 7–8 passengers, the following fee is not included in my booking and is paid directly to the captain at the dock before departure: a captain fee of $65/hr. and a fuel charge of $35/hr. will be charged to my credit card. A suggested 20% tip is not included.

The boat must have a captain. Please choose one of the three captains listed on the bareboat waiver, or contact Six Fins Charter at (305) 906-2880 for assistance.

Please complete all required forms in advance so we can depart on time.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

⚓ Your Experience – Open Itinerary & Fully Customizable

This private charter is designed entirely around you.

Popular experiences include:
• Dolphin watching
• Snorkeling vibrant reefs
• Sandbar relaxation stops
• Scenic harbor cruising
• Casual, family-friendly fishing (when arranged in advance and conditions permit)
• Backcountry eco exploration
• Romantic sunset cruising

🎣 Important Information About Combo Fishing

If fishing is included in your Custom Activities Combo, it is limited to 45 minutes and offered as a casual recreational activity within a multi-experience charter in the Gulf and backcountry. It is ideal for children, beginners, and families who would like to spend part of the day fishing while also enjoying activities such as sandbars, snorkeling, sightseeing, or dolphin watching. 

Available fishing time depends on your selected itinerary, travel time, weather, sea conditions, and how much of the charter you choose to devote to other activities. Combo fishing is not the same experience as a dedicated fishing charter and does not provide the same preparation, fishing time, effort, or fishing focus. Anyone 16 or older must purchase a 3-day non-resident license, which costs $17.00 online through [Go Outdoors Florida](https://license.gooutdoorsflorida.com/Licensing/CustomerLookup.aspx)

If you want a true Key West fishing experience, reserve our Private Patch Reef Fishing charter.

We select routes between Atlantic and Gulf waters based on weather and sea conditions to ensure comfort and safety.

Start times are flexible. The day is yours.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🛥 About the Boat

• 30' Jeanneau NC 895 Weekender cabin cruiser
• Private enclosed head (toilet)
• USCG-certified safety equipment
• Licensed USCG captains
• 5-star-reviewed experience

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

📍 Check-In Details

Location: Dock A, Slip #32
7001 Shrimp Rd, Stock Island, FL 33040

Free parking is available adjacent to The Perry Hotel & Marina.

Please arrive 15 minutes prior to departure.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🧳 What's Included

• Cooler with ice
• Bottled water & light snacks
• Adult noodles
• Snorkeling gear
• Basic fishing gear for casual Combo fishing (when arranged in advance and conditions permit). Limited to 45-minutes
• Lily pad (upon request)
• Stand-up paddleboard (upon request)
• Two bean bag chairs (upon request)

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🚫 Not Included

• Meals & beverages
• Towels
• Infant/toddler USCG-approved life jackets (must be provided by guest)
• Captain & crew gratuity (customary 20% minimum if satisfied)

Casual Combo fishing uses frozen bait only—no chum or live bait. Frozen bait is available at the customer’s expense.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🩺 Health & Safety

Your safety is our top priority.

• All charters follow USCG regulations
• Safety briefing provided before departure
• Life jackets available for all guests
• Activities are weather- and sea-condition dependent
• Food allergies or dietary restrictions: reply to this email and let us know in advance so we can prepare.
• Prone to seasickness: tell us ahead of time, and we'll suggest what to take before boarding.

Guests should be in good physical health and comfortable around water. Please notify us in advance if anyone has heart conditions, back or neck issues, recent surgeries, is pregnant, or has mobility limitations.

Children must be supervised at all times.

Excessive intoxication or unsafe behavior may result in early termination of the charter without refund.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

⚠ Disclaimers

• Itineraries are subject to weather, tides, and captain's discretion
• Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed
• Snorkeling and sandbar access depend on conditions
• Late arrivals may reduce charter time
• Six Fins is not responsible for lost or damaged personal items

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🎁 Complimentary Exclusive Access

As my charter guests, you may enjoy access to The Perry Hotel & Marina pools and fitness center before and after your trip.

Make a full day of it.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

⭐ Reviews

We would truly appreciate a review after your experience. Your feedback helps us continue delivering five-star private charters in Key West.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

Best regards,

David McFadden
Owner, Six Fins Charter

data.health_and_safety_notes:
Your safety is our highest priority.

All charters are operated by experienced, licensed captains who follow U.S. Coast Guard regulations and local safety guidelines. A safety briefing is provided prior to departure.

• U.S. Coast Guard–approved life jackets are provided for all guests
• Required safety equipment is onboard at all times
• Routes are selected based on current weather and sea conditions
• Activities such as snorkeling and swimming are supervised and weather-dependent

Guests should be in good physical health and comfortable around water. If you have medical conditions (including heart conditions, back or neck issues, recent surgeries, pregnancy, or mobility limitations), please consult your physician before booking and notify us in advance.

Children must be supervised by a parent or guardian at all times.

Guests who appear excessively intoxicated or unable to safely participate may be denied boarding or returned to the marina without refund.

Our captains reserve the right to modify the itinerary at any time for safety.

Food allergies and dietary restrictions: Please inform us in advance if you or anyone in your party has a food allergy or dietary restriction, so we can prepare accordingly. Reply to your confirmation email or call us.

Prone to seasickness: Let us know in advance and we can suggest what to take before you board.
data.disclaimers: All itineraries are subject to weather, sea conditions, U.S. Coast Guard advisories, and captain discretion; routes and activities may be adjusted for safety. Wildlife sightings are common but not guaranteed. Snorkeling, sandbar stops, casual fishing, and sunset timing depend on tides, wind, visibility, and seasonal conditions. Guests must arrive on time; late arrivals may reduce charter time without refund. Excessive intoxication, unsafe behavior, or failure to follow captain instructions may result in early termination without refund. Six Fins is not responsible for personal items lost, stolen, or damaged during the charter.
